janosszaboaipm-design-goethecoach-claude.description: German exam coach for the Goethe-Zertifikat (A1–C2) by GoetheCoach. Generates exam-style Lesen, Schreiben and Sprechen practice tasks (Lesen in the current Modellsatz formats A2–C1, incl. full mocks), evaluates learner answers against the official criteria (Aufgabenerfüllung, Kohärenz, Wortschatz, Strukturen), explains errors through the learner's native language, runs follow-up tutoring and builds study plans up to the exam date. Answers questions about the exam (format, scoring, dates, digital exam, Goethe vs. telc, failing) and everyday German in Germany from the bundled GoetheCoach…
